```
# UnifiedRandom (.NET Random 语义) —— /tmp/dgsrc/UnifiedRandom.cs 1:1
class UR:
    def __init__(self, seed: int):
        sa = [0] * 56
        num = abs(seed) if seed != -2**31 else 2**31 - 1
        num2 = 161803398 - num
        sa[55] = num2
        num3 = 1
        for j in range(1, 55):
            num4 = 21 * j % 55
            sa[num4] = num3
            num3 = num2 - num3
            if num3 < 0:
                num3 += 2147483647
            num2 = sa[num4]
        for _k in range(1, 5):
            for l in range(1, 56):
                sa[l] -= sa[1 + (l + 30) % 55]
                if sa[l] < 0:
                    sa[l] += 2147483647
        self.sa = sa
        self.inext = 0

    def internal_sample(self) -> int:
        num = self.inext + 1
        if num > 55:
            num = 1
        num2 = num + 21
        if num2 > 55:
            num2 -= 55
        num3 = self.sa[num] - self.sa[num2]
        if num3 == 2147483647:
            num3 -= 1
        num3 = num3 + ((num3 >> 31) & 0x7FFFFFFF)
        self.sa[num] = num3
        self.inext = num
        return num3

    def sample(self) -> float:
        return self.internal_sample() * 4.656612875245797e-10

    def next(self, mn=None, mx=None):
        if mn is None:
            return self.internal_sample()
        if mx is None:
            return int(self.sample() * mn)
        return int(self.sample() * (mx - mn)) + mn


def samples_at(seed: int, k0: int, n: int):
    """返回从第 k0 掷开始的连续 n 个 raw internal_sample 值（0-based 掷序）。"""
    u = UR(seed)
    for _ in range(k0):
        u.internal_sample()
    return [u.internal_sample() for _ in range(n)]

import re, sys
from pyur import samples_at

W, H = 4200, 1200
SEED = 9293480
TILE_DUNGEON = {41, 43, 44, 677, 678, 679}
WALL_DUNGEON = {7, 8, 9, 94, 95, 96, 97, 98, 99}

# SOLID 集（从 oracle 头部逐字提取）
src = open('~/Project/GLM/SandboxWorld/game/tools/golden/caves-oracle.cs').read()
m = re.search(r'var SOLID = new HashSet<ushort> \{(.*?)\};', src, re.S)
SOLID = set(int(x) for x in re.findall(r'\d+', m.group(1)))
m2 = re.search(r'var dgSolidTop = new HashSet<int> \{(.*?)\};', src, re.S)
SOLID_TOP = set(int(x) for x in re.findall(r'\d+', m2.group(1)))

def v16(b, i): return b[i*2] | (b[i*2+1] << 8)

def load_pd():
    t = open('/tmp/dgu/pd.typ', 'rb').read()
    act_txt = open('/tmp/dgu/pd.act', 'rb').read()  # text 0/1
    a = bytes(1 if c == 49 else 0 for c in act_txt)
    w = open('/tmp/dgu/pd', 'rb').read()
    return t, a, w

T, A, WL = load_pd()

dgBrick, dgWall, dgCrack = 44, 9, 483  # theme=2（绿砖）——由 dump 实测确认

def act(i): return A[i]
def typ(i): return v16(T, i)
def wal(i): return v16(WL, i)
def isDW(x): return x in WALL_DUNGEON
def isDT(x): return x in TILE_DUNGEON
def inWorld(x, y, fl): return fl <= x < W - fl and fl <= y < H - fl
def solid(x, y):
    if not (0 <= x < W and 0 <= y < H): return False
    i = y * W + x
    if A[i] == 0: return False
    t = v16(T, i)
    if t not in SOLID or t in SOLID_TOP: return False
    if t in (481, 482, 483): return False
    return True

def pit_trap(i, j, width, height, edgeW, topD):
    """DgPitTrap 1:1（oracle :5469-5548）。返回 (hit, fail_reason)。"""
    num = j; num2 = j
    if width < 1 or height < 1: return False, 'params'
    n6 = width + edgeW; n7 = height + topD
    if not inWorld(i, num, max(n6, n7)): return False, 'inworld'
    if not isDW(wal(num * W + i)): return False, 'anchorWall'
    if act(num * W + i) != 0: return False, 'anchorAct'
    found = False
    for k in range(num, H):
        if k > H - 200: return False, 'scan200'
        if act(k * W + i) != 0 and solid(i, k):
            if typ(k * W + i) == 48: return False, 'spike48'
            num = k; num2 = k; found = True
            break
    if not found: return False, 'scanNoSolid'
    if not isDW(wal(num * W + i - width)) or not isDW(wal(num * W + i + width)):
        return False, 'sideWalls'
    n8 = 30
    for n in range(num, num + n8):
        ok = True
        for x in range(i - width, i + width + 1):
            if act(n * W + x) != 0 and isDT(typ(n * W + x)): ok = False; break
        if ok: num = n; break
    if num + n7 >= H - 200: return False, 'bottom200'
    for x in range(i - width, i + width + 1):
        for y in range(num, num + height + 1):
            if act(y * W + x) != 0 and (isDT(typ(y * W + x)) or typ(y * W + x) == dgCrack):
                return False, 'innerDT'
    return True, 'HIT'

if __name__ == '__main__':
    L, R, B, N44 = 138, 668, 895, 337
    print('pit gate evaluation on static pre-pit grid (family ≡5 mod 6)')
    results = []
    for g in range(6659, 6978, 6):
        s = samples_at(SEED, g, 6)
        f = [x * 4.656612875245797e-10 for x in s]
        x3 = L + int(f[0] * (R - L))
        y2 = N44 + int(f[1] * (B - N44))
        n45 = 6 + int(f[2] * 4)
        wid = 8 + int(f[3] * 11)
        hgt = 19 + int(f[4] * 27)
        ew = 6 + int(f[5] * 4)
        hit, why = pit_trap(x3, y2, wid, hgt, ew, n45)
        results.append((g, x3, y2, wid, hgt, ew, n45, hit, why))
        if hit or g >= 6950:
            print(f'g={g} x3={x3} y2={y2} w={wid} h={hgt} ew={ew} td={n45} -> {"HIT" if hit else why}')
    hits = [r for r in results if r[7]]
    print('HIT groups ≡5 in [6659,6977]:', [r[0] for r in hits])

```

```
{
    for (int i = 0; i < typ.Length; i++) {
        hashTyp[i] = (ushort)(act[i] != 0 ? typ[i] : 0);
        hashGho[i] = (ushort)(act[i] == 0 ? typ[i] : 0); // inactive 格残留 type（幽灵 parity）
    }
    checkpoints.Add($"{name}|{Fnv16(hashTyp):x8} {Fnv8(act):x8} {Fnv16(wal):x8} {Fnv8(liq):x8}");
    ghostPts.Add($"{name}|{Fnv16(hashGho):x8}");
    // GRID_DUMP=pyramids:/tmp/cs-pyr → 命中检查点时落 typ(LE16)/act/wal(LE16)/liq 裸数组（对拍用）
    var gd = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("GRID_DUMP");
    if (gd != null && gd.Split(':')[0] == name)
    {
        string p = gd.Split(':')[1];
        File.WriteAllBytes(p + ".typ", ToBytes(typ));
        File.WriteAllBytes(p + ".act", act);
        File.WriteAllBytes(p + ".wal", ToBytes(wal));
        File.WriteAllBytes(p + ".liq", liq);
        Console.WriteLine($"griddump {name} -> {p}");
```

```
        private static void DumpGrids(string passName, int W, int H, Terraria.Tile[,] tile)
        {
            string dumpAll = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("SW_DUMP_ALL");
            if (dumpAll != null)
            {
                try

                    StringBuilder sbn = new StringBuilder();
                    foreach (char ch in passName)
                        sbn.Append(char.IsLetterOrDigit(ch) ? ch : '_');
                    WriteGrid(dumpAll + "/" + _idx.ToString("000") + "_" + sbn.ToString(), W, H, tile);
                }
                catch (Exception e) { Mark("#dumpall-ex " + passName + " " + e.GetType().Name + ": " + e.Message); }
                return;
            }
            string cfg = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("SW_GRID_DUMP");
            if (cfg == null) return;
            foreach (string one in cfg.Split(','))
            {
                string[] kv = one.Split(':');
                if (kv.Length != 2 || kv[0] != passName) continue;
                try
                {
                    WriteGrid(kv[1], W, H, tile);
                    Mark("#griddump " + passName + " -> " + kv[1]);
                }
                catch (Exception e) { Mark("#griddump-ex " + passName + " " + e.GetType().Name + ": " + e.Message); }
            }
        }
```

````
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Text;

namespace Terraria.WorldBuilding
{
    public static class DgSegProbe
    {
        private static string _path;
        private static FieldInfo _fiSeedArray;
        private static FieldInfo _fiInext;
        private static string DumpPath()
        {
            if (_path == null)
            {
                _path = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("SW_DGSEG");
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_path)) _path = "/tmp/dgu/home/dgseg_default.txt";
            }
            return _path;
        }
        public static void Mark(float percentile, string debugString)
        {
            try
            {
                if (_fiSeedArray == null)
                {
                    var urt = typeof(Terraria.WorldGen).Assembly.GetType("Terraria.Utilities.UnifiedRandom");
                    _fiSeedArray = urt.GetField("SeedArray", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance);
                    _fiInext = urt.GetField("inext", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance);
                }
                var r = Terraria.WorldGen.genRand;
                var usa = (int[])_fiSeedArray.GetValue(r);
                uint uix = (uint)_fiInext.GetValue(r);
                uint fh = 2166136261u;
````

````
```csharp
void DgPrefixRolls(int item)
{
    var arr = DgPrefixClass(item);
    if (arr == null) return;
    while (true)
    {
        if ((int)r.Next(4) == 0) return;                       // rolledPrefix=0 → TryGet(0) 恒过 → 终
        int rolled = arr[(int)r.Next(arr.Length)];
        if (DgPre.Reduced.Contains(rolled) && (int)r.Next(3) != 0) return;   // 击落 0 → 终
        if (DgPre.TryGetFails(item, rolled)) continue;         // TryGet 败 → rolledPrefix=-1 重掷全链
        return;
    }
}
```

Wait — ORDER subtlety! In vanilla the Reduced gate happens BEFORE TryGet, and if Reduced knocks to 0 → the loop EXITS with prefix 0 (no retry even though... TryGet(0) fine). 	public static DungeonGenerationStyleData GetStyleForWall(List<DungeonGenerationStyleData> styles, int wallType)
````
```json
	{
```

```json
		{
```

```json
			{
```
```
				return style;

				}
			}
		}
		return null;
	}
```

```
using Terraria.GameContent.Generation.Dungeon.Features;

namespace Terraria.GameContent.Generation.Dungeon.Entrances;

public abstract class DungeonEntrance
{
	public DungeonEntranceSettings settings;

	public bool calculated;

	public bool generated;

	public DungeonBounds Bounds = new DungeonBounds();

	public Point OldManSpawn;

	public bool Processed
	{
		get
		{
			if (!calculated)
			{
				return generated;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

	public DungeonEntrance(DungeonEntranceSettings settings)
	{
		this.settings = settings;
	}

	public abstract void CalculateEntrance(DungeonData data, int x, int y);

	public abstract bool GenerateEntrance(DungeonData data, int x, int y);

	public virtual bool CanGenerateFeatureAt(DungeonData data, IDungeonFeature feature, int x, int y)
	{
		if (feature is DungeonGlobalBiomeChests)
		{
			return false;
		}
		return true;
	}
}
```

```
import { it } from 'vitest';
import { readFileSync, existsSync } from 'node:fs';
import { TILE_DEFS } from '../src/data/tiles';

const W = 4200, H = 1200;
const READY = existsSync('/tmp/cs-dgi.typ') && existsSync('/tmp/js-dgi.typ');

function loadTyp(p: string, mapped: boolean): Int32Array {
  const buf = readFileSync(p);
  const n = W * H;
  const out = new Int32Array(n);
  let vid: Int32Array | null = null;
  if (mapped) {
    vid = new Int32Array(TILE_DEFS.length).fill(-1);
    for (let i = 0; i < TILE_DEFS.length; i++) {
      const s = TILE_DEFS[i]?.vanilla?.sheet;
      if (typeof s === 'number') vid[i] = s;
    }
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const v = buf.readUInt16LE(i * 2);
    out[i] = mapped ? (vid ? vid[v] : v) : v;
  }
  return out;
}
```
